record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change only masked-item cross-entropy temperature from 0.8 to 1.0, retaining uniform masked-target weighting and zero label smoothing. Softer logits may improve optimization of the normalized tied item representations without introducing the uniform-target pressure of the regressed smoothing trial. Preserve masked sampling, features, embeddings, topology, scoring, appended-mask readout, optimizer and training schedule; prediction still uses the single model's original scores.
